label: McVerry et al. (2006)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA and PGA0, larger component) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: McVerry et al. (2006)

site.note: Use the NZ classes. A and B are combined as the reference; class E is outside the model. Do not translate them to a generic Vs30 model.

volcanic_zone.note: Volcanic-zone path length/effect is part of the published path term.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for each tectonic branch. Both PGA and PGA0 coefficient sets and the magnitude-dependent sigma rule are now available. The NZ site classes and the volcanic-zone path variable are still not enumerated by the appendix.

implementation_notes: Branches share only the terms the original model shares - do not factor them together further.
Test presence and absence of the volcanic-zone path contribution.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Crustal + interface + intraslab; NZ path/site treatment.
parameters.component_note: RESOLVED: the appendix states the anchor branches are for the larger horizontal component.

branches.PGA0: second published coefficient set in the appendix

aleatory.rule: sigma = sigma_M6 + sigma_slope*(Mw-6) for 5<Mw<7; sigma = sigma_M6 - sigma_slope for Mw<5; sigma = sigma_M6 + sigma_slope for Mw>7

resolution_provenance.site.classes: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.230: NZ classes A (strong rock) and B (rock) combined as the reference; C shallow soil (delta_C = 1); D deep or soft soil (delta_D = 1); class E data not used
resolution_provenance.mechanism.classes: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.230: crustal events only -- strike-slip (CN = 0, CR = 0), normal (CN = -1), oblique-reverse (CR = 0.5), reverse (CR = 1); mechanism found not significant for subduction events
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/mcverry_2006.py coefficient table; period count and range (11 periods, 0.075-3 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.
